about: The one source for the fixed lists. build.py writes base/flags.md, the Lists tab of the template and lists.csv from this file. Edit here, then run python3 build.py.

areas.means: Messages, posts, campaigns, the website, brand and audience
areas.example: The launch post got no replies because it opened with the product, not the customer's problem

areas.means: Leads, quotes, proposals, follow-up and pricing to a customer
areas.example: A quote sent without a valid-until date was accepted three months later at the old price

areas.means: Service, complaints, onboarding and what customers actually want
areas.example: Customers stopped asking where their order was once the dispatch email gave a tracking link

areas.means: How a choice was made: the options, the evidence, and what we would weigh differently
areas.example: We chose the cheapest supplier on price alone and paid for it in late deliveries

areas.means: Suppliers, scheduling, delivery and the steps of the work itself
areas.example: The crew arrived before the materials because the delivery was booked by phone, not in writing

areas.means: Invoices, payments, costs, budgets and the numbers behind them
areas.example: Month-end took two extra days because receipts were collected at the end, not weekly

areas.means: Hiring, delegating, training and working with a team or contractor
areas.example: A task handed over with no example came back wrong twice

areas.means: Software, scripts, spreadsheets with formulas, and building with agents
areas.example: The agent rewrote the whole page when asked for one fix

areas.means: Prompts, instructions, checking AI output and what a chatbot gets wrong
areas.example: The summary invented a date because the transcript did not have one

areas.means: Anything that fits none of the above. Three rows on the same theme suggest a new area
areas.example: The office move went faster once each desk had a numbered box list

lesson_types.means: A step was missing, in the wrong order or done twice
A tool, app or platform behaved in a way we did not expect
How something was asked, of a person or an AI, decided the result
A check would have caught it, or did
A rule of thumb for a decision
Who was told what, when, and how
Something learned about customers, the market or the work that changes what we do

kinds.means: Work had to be rebuilt or rewritten
A departure from the usual way that worked better than expected
